title: A/P Detail: the PDF and CSV match the rows and order on screen
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column shows on screen and in the exports.
  • Have two vendors, vendor A and vendor B, with open documents at both locations on today's date, at least two each, with different amounts.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the Vendor filter showing vendor A and vendor B ticked and every group expanded (Expand all).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open Balance" header once.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the downloaded PDF and compare its rows with the screen, top to bottom.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open the CSV in a spreadsheet program and compare its rows with the screen.
  6. Without refreshing the page, click the "Date" header.
  7. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu again.
  8. Open the new CSV and compare its rows with the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rows sort by Open Balance, largest first.

Step 2:

  • The PDF downloads as a file.
  • The "Success" message "Data exported successfully." shows.

Step 3:

  • The PDF holds exactly the rows on screen for vendor A and vendor B, in the same order, and has a "Location" column, as the screen does (two locations are in view).

Step 4:

  • The CSV downloads.
  • The "Success" message "Data exported successfully." shows.

Step 5:

  • The CSV holds exactly the same rows in the same order, with a "Location" column.

Step 6:

  • The rows re-sort by Date.

Step 7:

  • The CSV downloads with the "Success" message.

Step 8:

  • The new CSV follows the new on-screen order, by Date, not the earlier Open Balance order.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S3-R2: “The PDF downloads as a file.”
  • S3-R3: “The PDF and the CSV contain exactly the rows on screen for the chosen as-of date, customer or vendor and locations, in the on-screen sort, including a sort changed after an earlier export, without refreshing the page.”
  • S3-R6: “The Location column appears in the export under the same rule as on screen (Story 6).”
  • S3-R10: “A successful export shows the native "Success" message, "Data exported successfully." An export with no rows downloads nothing and shows the native warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export succeeds | "Success", "Data exported successfully." | Success toast, as on the other reports”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”
